_: The one case table for order arithmetic. Read by backend/tests/unit/
test_orders.py and by frontend/src/lib/orders.test.ts, so the two
implementations cannot drift: the whole point of duplicating the
arithmetic is that the button preview needs no round trip, and the whole
risk of duplicating it is that one side quietly stops agreeing.
Add a case here, not to one suite.

limits.why: sub-dollar: the finer Rule 612 tick applies
a buy priced up through $1 takes the penny tick
a sell priced down through $1 takes the fine tick
just under the 33.33 crossover: cents still win
just over it: basis points take the offset past 5c
$41: 15bps is 6.2c, and the ceil lands off the raw tick
expensive name, offset is wholly proportionate
two-cent stock: the sell clamps to one tick, not below zero
ask already exactly on a tick is not nudged a penny up

buy_shares.why: $10 is dead above $10 a share — zero is an ordinary answer
only the largest button survives a $41 name
exact division must not come out one share short

sell_shares.why: ALL is the position exactly, never a proportion of it
25% of three shares is nothing — the button disables
flat: every sell button is dead
long only — a short position sells nothing, it does not cover
